what: Instead of page scrolling, you look around a panel larger than the window (notes, map) by dragging it by hand. On release it keeps gliding, slowing the speed at that moment over .8s with easeOutQuad, and an axis that touches an edge stops immediately. Wheel and trackpad push the panel as is, ctrl+wheel and two-finger spread zoom around the cursor position, and the ± buttons zoom in and out by .2 over .3s easeInOutCubic (.5~1.4×, never below the scale that covers the whole window). Dragging the red rectangle on the small map makes the panel follow, and clicking a table-of-contents link flies it over 1s easeInOutCubic so that section lands 50px from the top left (or right)

options.focus: Board coordinate ‹x,y› to sit at the window center at first, default board center — Brand 1649,1215
options.fly: Duration of flying to the table of contents (sec), default 1
options.zoom-step: Zoom step per ± button press, default .2
options.min: Smallest scale, default .5 (never smaller than the scale that covers the whole window)
options.phone-scale: Initial scale at widths of 767px or below, default .8
options.wheel: If y, the wheel pushes the panel vertically only (default: both horizontal and vertical)
options.wheel-speed: Multiplier per wheel notch, default 1 — FOCAL is .5
options.steps: ± buttons’ list of zoom scales to step through (comma separated) — fit (scale that covers the whole window) · mid (halfway between fit and 1) · numbers. If given, it steps one at a time instead of using zoom-step
options.zoom-ease: Zoom curve — ease (CSS ease) or ‹x1,y1,x2,y2›, default easeInOutCubic
options.gap: Distance (px) from the window edge at which a section flown to the table of contents drops, default 50
options.[data-fx-part=viewport]: Window — the attached element itself if none
options.[data-fx-part=map]·[data-fx-part=indicat: (If present) minimap and the rectangle showing the current view inside it
options.[data-fx-part=zoom-in]·[data-fx-part=zoo: (if present) zoom in and out buttons — disabled when they reach the end
options.[data-fx-part=goto]: (If any) href="#Inside panel id" Link that jumps to that area, href="#" is the starting position. data-side="right" Align to the right edge of the plane
options.is-locked: While the attached element has this class it takes no interaction (during intro or modal)

About
note: A ”large board explorer” like drag-pan-map (Draggable · InertiaPlugin inertia), but with wheel push, zoom and table-of-contents fly-to added, and inertia based on a velocity decay formula, so it is kept separate. Dragging the board is this part’s job, so touch on the board is blocked — a board covering the full window height would stop the page from scrolling on that screen, so attach it only when the board is used as the whole page (the entire first screen). · FOCAL: the original zooms from the window center using the page’s top-left as the reference point, but this part uses the board center as the reference, so positions drift a little differently during zoom.
